snippet.title: Starsand Island | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
You left your job in the big city and moved to a charming island to start a new rural life! Here, you can collect treasures by the sea, go fishing, grow crops, and raise animals. 

You can also become close friends or even lovers with the townsfolk, learning their signature recipes or how to craft useful tools. 

With completely freeform object DIY, you can create a world that’s uniquely your own, and invite other players to join you and share in this wonderful experience!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/starsand-island/9p86lldcl5cc
